label: Cave / Underground
description: Underground landforms as hero subjects — the light is always borrowed, single-source or self-made.

items.name: stalactite-hall
items.text: a limestone hall where stalactites and stalagmites meet in full columns, every surface wet-glossed with flowstone

items.name: sea-cave-shaft
items.text: a sea cave under a collapsed roof, one shaft of light dropping onto turquoise water, the walls black around the glow

items.name: crystal-beams
items.text: selenite crystal beams the size of felled trees crossing a cave void, faces glassy above hot mineral haze

items.name: lava-tube
items.text: a basalt lava tube running arrow-straight, walls ribbed with frozen flow lines, a green-lit skylight breach far ahead

items.name: jungle-cenote
items.text: a jungle cenote, roots and vines dropping thirty meters from the rim to still ultramarine water

items.name: glowworm-grotto
items.text: a grotto ceiling constellated with blue glowworm lures, each hanging its beaded silk snare, doubled in black still water

items.name: cave-pearls
items.text: a nest of cave pearls in a shallow flowstone pool, each stone sphere polished into concentric shells by centuries of dripwater turning it in place
